title: Active-learning prioritisation and calibrated agents — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live clinical review screening or prospective human calibration decisions.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval. Convergence centered on the non-negotiable prohibition of automated study exclusion (auto_exclusion_prohibited: true), transparent deterministic lexical ranking, WSS@95% screening effort reduction (>60%), robust empirical calibration curves with division-by-zero protection, adversarial prompt injection resilience, anti-sycophantic context isolation, and honest preservation of open maturity gates.
convergence_vectors: Strict runtime and schema enforcement of auto_exclusion_prohibited: true
Advisory-only study prioritisation requiring human approver and minimum sensitivity verification
Deterministic lexical ranker with transparent title/abstract/subject feature attribution
Empirical calibration curve calculation (sensitivity, precision, FNR, FPR, WSS@95) with zero-division guards
Adversarial prompt injection defense treating study texts strictly as inert data tokens
Multi-agent scoring context isolation preventing shared-context leakage or sycophancy
divergence_vectors: Quantile versus uniform static step threshold selection for future empirical calibration curves
Integration of domain-specific lemmatisation (MeSH/EBI) into lexical tokenisation pipeline

assertions_evaluated.notes: Outcome-gradable screening benchmark and threshold calibration schemas defined in RankingCalibration and verified via test_outcome_gradable_screening_benchmark_and_wss95 and test_active_learning_ranking_governance.py.
Transparent deterministic LexicalRanker with title/abstract/subject weighting and feature attribution implemented in searchright-ranking; bitwise reproducibility and comparative models verified.

Empirical calibration curves for sensitivity/recall, precision, FNR, FPR, and WSS@95 implemented in searchright-ranking::calibrate with zero-division protection and verified against human gold decisions.
Independent strategy generator and PRESS adversary roles modeled; adversarial prompt injection countermeasures verified treating study text strictly as data tokens.
Isolated scoring pipelines prevent shared-context leakage and sycophantic concession between primary screening ranker and adversarial reviewer.

Non-negotiable rule forbidding automatic study exclusion strictly enforced by contract and schema invariants (auto_exclusion_prohibited: true); stopping rules remain disabled pending external evidence.

panel_recommendations: Retain mandatory auto_exclusion_prohibited: true invariant across all future ranking and active-learning pipelines.
Preserve strict separation between advisory prioritisation ordering and autonomous screening decisions.
Maintain honest claim boundaries distinguishing fixture-proven ranking and adversary simulations from live prospective clinical trials.
open_gates: Run SYNERGY and topic-held-out calibration benchmarks.
Complete prospective human calibration and subgroup error analysis.
Keep stopping/exclusion authority disabled until external evidence and governance approve it.
